name: ux-designer
description: Plan and improve content, navigation, task flows, and interaction states for websites, web apps, iOS, and Android.

interface.longDescription: A coordinated set of six skills that inspects your materials, clarifies the task in plain language, plans the interface, implements authorized changes, and checks the result.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ux-designer:design-interface to improve content, navigation, and task flows in this project.
